dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures exhibit thin, high-intensity light-colored perimeters with irregular, non-smooth outer boundaries. The transition from the low-intensity (dark) exterior base to the light perimeter is characterized by a high-contrast step-function, while the interior shows a decrease in pixel intensity towards the center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters is visible on the anterior dorsal region. These clusters are amorphous, lack internal gradients, and are more closely packed near the dorsal-lateral transition compared to the mid-dorsal midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular pentagonal geometry. The spatial relationship between the two most anterior centroids and the three mid-dorsal centroids defines a primary triangle with two supplementary vertices forming a trailing edge.
